text:
alex: quick sync — putting together the PRD acceptance checklist for the crypto + logs work. question: do we require HSM-integration for GA or can we ship with KMS + a clear roadmap?
maria: we need a decision today for scope planning. legal/customer asks are pushing HSM for some enterprise deals. but that adds ~2 sprints to infra.
raj: security POV: HSM is preferred for key custody for SOC2/ISO customers. but we can mitigate with a documented KMS config + enforced access controls and MFK rotation. tradeoff is time-to-market.
sam: implementation details — current private deploy supports external KMS via customer-managed keys (CMKs). HSM path means adding PKCS#11 shim and testing on Dedicated GPUs + private. effort estimate: 6w for integration + perf testing.
lina: privacy/regulatory: if we promise HSM as part of launch for regulated customers, we need clear labeling in contract and marketing. otherwise, must add explicit limitations in SOW.
maria: proposed acceptance criteria for PRD GA (draft):
 - encryption: all at-rest model artifacts and runtime cache encrypted with customer CMK or Redwood-managed key; key rotation tested end-to-end;
 - KMS coverage: API flows for key use, rotation, and revocation; automated alerts for key errors;
 - HSM readiness: documented integration plan + CI smoke test that can run against a test HSM in staging (not blocking GA for hosted tier);
 - audit logs: immutable append-only logs for key operations and admin actions, retention 7y for enterprise, 1y default; exportable to customer SIEM;
 - acceptance tests: infra e2e that proves failover to KMS fallback policy and preserves latency SLA <200ms P95 for control plane operations;
 - compliance artifacts: SOC2 checklist items completed, ISO gap doc signed off by security.
raj: small requests on that list: please replace 'immutable append-only' with 'tamper-evident with WORM option' — true immutability depends on storage backend. also, retention policies need retention exception process.
sec-bot: incident policy reminder — any change to key rotation automation requires a runbook and a pre-merge safety flag.
alex: good call. also need to enumerate edge cases for PRD:
 - customer revokes CMK mid-run; how do we surface errors gracefully and allow safe drain?
 - cross-region replica keys mismatch on failover;
 - upgrade path from KMS-only to HSM for Dedicated customers without downtime.
sam: for revoke case: propose a 'read-only bake' state where new inferences fail with 429 and existing sessions are allowed to finish for X minutes; UI + API should surface a clear error code and remediation link.
maria: from product side, add launch gating: HSM not required for hosted GA but must be in alpha for Dedicated customers with a doc-driven timeline; KMS + documented fallback must be in place for hosted GA. if customers require HSM at sign-up, route to Private/Dedicated pre-GA.
lina: retention exceptions: add an approval workflow via legal + privacy + security ops, logged to the same tamper-evident log.
raj: acceptance test to add: simulate key compromise scenario and validate automatic revocation & rotation workflow plus alerting to oncall.
alex: plan: update PRD with these criteria and circulate RFC by EOD. owners: infra (sam) for HSM path, security (raj) for compliance artifacts, product (maria) for acceptance tests & marketing language.
maria: i'll draft RFC and ping stakeholders. tagging @sam @raj @lina for visibility.
sec-bot: deploy-checklist update required: add 'kms-rotation-smoke' and 'hsm-pkcs11-smoke' to pre-release pipelines.
sam: noted, will add pipeline jobs this week.
alex: thanks all — if no objections i'll lock the PRD scope at 3pm UTC and start scheduling sprints. :thumbsup:
